title: How much GPU memory does the P2 training recipe use, and how does it scale with channels and batch?
hypothesis: The P2 runs never recorded GPU memory, so the headroom for larger channels or batch is unknown. With the EXP-0027 recipe (crop 1.6 s, 24 kHz, ResidualUNet 16 channels, batch 8, FP32) on the 4090 Laptop 16 GB card, torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated stays under 1.0 GB and max_memory_reserved under 2.0 GB, and doubling channels or batch size at most quadruples allocated memory. If the baseline already exceeds 1 GB, the 8x-headroom assumption behind the next training plan is wrong and must be reported before scaling.

gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Laptop GPU (16375.5 MiB)
notes: Memory-only probe (20 steps, no convergence claim). The 1.0 GB baseline assumption was wrong: ch16/batch8 allocates 1347 MB (about 168 MB per 1.6 s sample), so real headroom on the 16 GB card is about 12x, and roughly 9-10x after a 20% safety margin. Doubling channels or batch only doubles memory, which points at activations rather than parameters. Extrapolations to ch32/batch32 (~10 GB) are untested. EXP-0025/0026/0027 still have no per-step GPU memory instrumentation.
